title: RAI launches on Ethereum mainnet
description: Reflexer launched RAI as an ETH-backed stable-value asset using a floating protocol redemption price rather than a fixed one-dollar peg.
notes: Launch date is corroborated by Reflexer community resources and contemporary protocol material.

title: RAI governance-minimization process
description: Reflexer documentation describes a staged process for removing or constraining governance control over RAI components while retaining maintenance for infrastructure that cannot be fully ungoverned.
notes: No single completion date is assigned because the official material describes stages and component-specific constraints.

title: Paxos launches PAX Gold
description: Paxos launched PAXG as an Ethereum token representing one fine troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold held in professional London vaults and redeemable through Paxos subject to terms.
notes: Official Paxos launch release and whitepaper.

title: Tether Gold XAU₮ launches
description: Tether announced XAU₮ as a token providing ownership of allocated physical gold, with one token representing one fine troy ounce on an LBMA Good Delivery bar.
notes: Official Tether launch release and Tether Gold product documentation.

title: SPOT v2 in-place rollout is proposed
description: Ampleforth governance proposed an in-place SPOT v2 upgrade adding SPOT-to-AMPL swapping and a dynamic rotation-fee system. The signal vote passed on April 19, 2024. Existing SPOT and stAMPL holders did not need to migrate, and the underlying ButtonTranche contracts were unchanged.
notes: The proposal and signal-vote result are day-level facts. The exact production activation transaction date remains unresolved.

title: Nuon v2 opens publicly on Base
description: Nuon opened its redesigned v2 protocol to the wider public on March 3, 2025. Users could mint NUON 1:1 against USDC and stake on Base. SOG records this as a v2 public relaunch rather than the original asset launch.
notes: The original branded-asset launch remains the 2023 Arbitrum v1 release. Contract and holder continuity are not inferred.

title: Nuon v2 guarded launch opens to selected community users
description: Nuon v2 opened its Base guarded-launch phase to the Truflation community on February 28, 2025 before the wider public opening on March 3.
notes: This restricted phase is separate from both the 2023 v1 launch and the March 3 v2 public opening.

title: Nuon v1 launches on Arbitrum mainnet
description: Nuon Protocol released its first public mainnet version on Arbitrum on February 2, 2023 in a guarded format. This is the canonical launch date for the Nuon branded asset lineage.
notes: Nuon v1 used a CDP-style architecture and a different Arbitrum token contract from the later Base v2 deployment.

title: SPOT launches on Ethereum mainnet
description: Ampleforth announced SPOT live on Ethereum mainnet on December 8, 2022. The initial release used capped minting and conservative tranche parameters while exposing the continuous SPOT ERC-20 token now retained through later in-place upgrades.
notes: This is the canonical launch boundary. Later v2 and v5 changes are protocol upgrades, not new asset launches.

title: SPOT v5.0 upgrade is executed on-chain
description: Ampleforth governance reported that the SPOT v5.0 upgrade had executed on-chain and the system was functioning smoothly. The upgrade separated enrichment and debasement from rotations, introduced DR-based fees, directed fees to stAMPL holders, and enabled paired SPOT and stAMPL minting and redemption.
notes: A follow-up fee-curve adjustment was reported executed on July 24, 2025; it is not treated as a separate asset version.
